description: deep-mode containment guard: once a /deep-mode: command runs in a session, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit outside the project root are denied for the rest of that session, resumes included

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/deep-mode/assets/contain/claude_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; for py in python3 python; do if "$py" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$py" "$f" activate "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"; fi; done; echo "deep-mode write guard: no Python 3.8+ on PATH, so writes are not fenced" >&2; exit 1

f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/deep-mode/assets/contain/claude_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; for py in python3 python; do if "$py" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$py" "$f" if-active "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"; fi; done; echo "deep-mode write guard: no Python 3.8+ on PATH, so writes are not fenced" >&2; exit 1
